name: NT tertiary fares reimbursement (within the NT)
summary: Reimburses up to three return trips a year for NT students living away from home to study full-time at an NT tertiary institution.
key: A maximum of three return trips per academic year may be reimbursed.
who: Applicant and student must be NT residents
Student studies full-time at an NT tertiary institution
Student may only work a part-time, non-salaried job
how: Complete the Tertiary fares reimbursement application form in GrantsNT by 30 September.
Provide proof of full-time enrolment and your primary residential address.
catches: Apply by 30 September each year; submit the claim form by 31 March of the following year.
Charter flights will not be reimbursed.

source.label: NT.GOV.AU: Tertiary fares reimbursement within the NT

evidence.quote: A maximum of three return trips per academic year may be reimbursed.
living away from home and studying full-time in an NT or interstate tertiary institution
